name: eta
description: Agent-supplied turn ETAs with local calibration for Codex desktop.

interface.longDescription: The primary Codex agent supplies and revises its estimate of time remaining in the current turn. A desktop companion counts down from that estimate. Local SQLite history compares actual duration against agent predictions to calibrate future estimates. Missing or expired estimates are shown explicitly. Requires Windows, Python 3.10 or later, and trusted Codex lifecycle hooks. The window is separate from Codex's model indicator.
capabilities: Ask the agent for remaining time
